title: Dynamic Dual-Feedback Conformal Inference for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.26987v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantifying uncertainty in time series forecasting is particularly demanding because sequential data exhibit temporal dependence and are prone to distributional changes. Conformal inference has emerged as a powerful uncertainty quantification approach through the construction of prediction sets. Recent advances have introduced online conformal methods that adaptively adjust prediction thresholds through feedback mechanisms. However, the existing feedback mechanism typically relies solely on miscoverage indicators (actual feedback), whether the true label falls within the interval at each time step, while overlooking the empirical prediction threshold (estimated feedback) that is derived from the oracle conformal method. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Dual-feedback Conformal Inference (DDCI), which incorporates a dual-feedback mechanism consisting of actual feedback and estimated feedback. translated_title: 用于时间序列预测的动态双反馈保形推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.26987v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：时间序列预测中的不确定性量化要求尤为苛刻，因为序列数据具有时间依赖性，且容易发生分布变化。保形推断通过构造预测集合，已成为一种强大的不确定性量化方法。近期的研究进展引入了在线保形方法，通过反馈机制自适应地调整预测阈值。然而，现有的反馈机制通常仅依赖误覆盖指示器（实际反馈），即在每个时间步真实标签是否落在区间内，而忽视了由理想保形方法推导出的经验预测阈值（估计反馈）。在本文中，我们提出了动态双反馈保形推断（DDCI），它融合了由实际反馈和估计反馈组成的双反馈机制。前者驱动主要的调整……
tldr: 该论文提出动态双反馈保形推断（DDCI），通过同时利用误覆盖指示的实际反馈和基于理想保形方法的估计反馈来自适应调整预测阈值，从而在分布变化环境下实现更可靠的时间序列预测不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dynamic Dual-feedback Conformal Inference (DDCI), which adaptively adjusts prediction thresholds by combining both actual feedback (miscoverage indicators) and estimated feedback (empirical thresholds derived from the oracle conformal method) for more reliable uncertainty quantification in time series forecasting.
